subject.title: BL-ecommerce-seo: SEO — specs, aislamiento y tests

question: Should https://github.com/Hamelyn-SL/hamelyn-serverless/pull/7152 be accepted as the F1-F5 implementation for the Ecommerce SEO BL block, or should the block be split or restarted before merge?
rationale: The issue asks for owner-validated business-logic extraction, and the open PR expands the estimated six-rule block into 65 rules across 84 changed files, so maintainer owner/reviewer judgment is required before this can be considered complete.

options.title: Review and land PR 7152
options.body: Accept the current split into SEO sub-subdomains if the owner/reviewer agree the 65 validated specs, isolated functions, and tests satisfy the block definition of done.

options.title: Narrow or split the block
options.body: Ask the PR author to reduce the branch into smaller BL PRs if the current SEO surface is too large to review safely in one merge.

options.title: Restart the implementation path
options.body: Close the PR and keep this issue as the parent if maintainers decide the extraction needs a different boundary or owner validation pass.

recommendation.title: Review and land PR 7152
recommendation.body: Accept the current split into SEO sub-subdomains if the owner/reviewer agree the 65 validated specs, isolated functions, and tests satisfy the block definition of done.
